title: docs(spec): agent-consumption optim — strip decision-history in agent view, ask slices, hybrid-drilldown resident, README positioning
feat(section,mcp): agent view strips decision-history materialization — read thick pages without burning journal
why:
R1 of the benchmark cost more via wiki (102k>83k) because agentView kept
the decision-history sentinel region (tens of KB). view=agent now strips
it too, leaving a pointer line; decision history is fetched on demand via
section=Decision history.

why:
The wiki group burned tokens doing ask.js (path only) then Read whole page.
CLI now prints the matched section's slice (with its func@file anchors)
inline; --paths keeps the old path-only output for scripts.
